scope: Two-state Boolean safety proof after global reset for the lower35 command bits of the current placed reproduction at its internal16-bit receive boundary. Verifies header assembly, valid/ready acceptance, queue stalls and the accepted tag/opcode echoed by response fields. This transport is reproduction infrastructure; it is not a paper performance result.

method.history: The receive observer updates only on an actual valid/ready receive transfer. The accepted snapshot updates only on an actual valid/ready command transfer. A queued command cannot relabel the last accepted command.
method.reset: Only observer validity and write history reset. Receive data and both software data snapshots remain initially arbitrary.
method.lifetime: The most recently accepted tag/opcode is retained through response retirement until another actual command acceptance or reset. The accepted-seen flag is not an active-service flag.
method.induction: Reset basis and actual-cell clock induction use the same77 physical current/next register equations. Untracked inputs and storage remain arbitrary.
method.future_input_immunity: The two command/response field expressions depend on70 tracked physical bits and no input or untracked-state symbols. The independent audit also varies all nontracked equation symbols.

physical_faults: invert actual dispatcher saved-tag next bit0 on command acceptance
hold actual receive-record bit17 during the second received word
observer_faults: capture a merely visible queued command while ready is false
verification.fault_interpretation: Deliberate model corruptions test proof sensitivity. Their witnesses are not claims of reset-reachable faults in the unchanged hardware.
verification.independent_reconstruction: Separate definition reader, sum-based field assembly, differently structured history contract and fresh symbols; shares the authenticated actual-cell equation export, not an independent netlist re-extraction.
